jobs.prompt: Original detailed high-density wuxia 2D game VFX, crisp continuous shapes and controlled bright cores. Create a FOUR COLUMN BY FOUR ROW 16-cel atlas, 2048 square. Each ROW is a different effect, each COLUMN is its chronological animation phase: gathering, clear active/flight, impact/strong active, fade. Row1: red-orange broad saber-qi projectile directed RIGHT. Row2: thin red-orange ground lava crack followed by a sharp small eruption. Row3: red-gold arrow/bolt directed RIGHT with dark metal core. Row4: red-orange descending cannon fire impact with compact debris and embers. For directional cels all point RIGHT. All effects are independent isolated alpha shapes, no body or text. Exactly 16 complete cels, fully inside their cells and separated with generous transparent gutters. No white/grey/colored matte, NO fog rectangles, no checkerboard, no gradients filling the cells. Every unused pixel and every quadrant corner is alpha zero. Same emission centre and scale across each row. Ground formations use the fixed elevated top-down elliptical view.
